description: This file defines the Theme class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet namespace, representing theme-related properties such as color schemes and fonts for spreadsheet styling.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents theme configuration for spreadsheet styling, including color schemes and font settings.

methods.name: getThemeColors
methods.description: Returns the current theme colors array.

methods.name: setThemeColor
methods.description: Sets a specific color in the theme colors array.

methods.name: getThemeColorName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the current theme color scheme.

methods.name: setThemeColorName
methods.description: Sets the theme color scheme name and optionally updates the color palette accordingly.

methods.name: getMajorFontLatin
methods.description: Gets the primary Latin font for the theme.

methods.name: getMajorFontEastAsian
methods.description: Gets the East Asian font for the theme.

methods.name: getMajorFontComplexScript
methods.description: Gets the Complex Script font for the theme.

methods.name: getMajorFontSubstitutions
methods.description: Returns the map of major (header) font substitutions.

methods.name: setMajorFontValues
methods.description: Sets the major font values and substitutions.

methods.name: getMinorFontEastAsian
methods.description: Gets the minor East Asian font.

methods.name: getMinorFontComplexScript
methods.description: Gets the minor Complex Script font.

methods.name: getMinorFontSubstitutions
methods.description: Returns the map of minor font substitutions.

methods.name: setMinorFontValues
methods.description: Sets the minor font values and substitutions.
